concern_results.conclusion: No bypass reproduced: hook quiet requires covered=1 (moves_head=0, clean, commit-or-tree equality) AND status exactly "passed", so covered findings/missing("?")/unknown status remind via the dedicated branch whose note/message cannot be overwritten ([ "$covered" != 1 ] guard), and the findings vs status-less texts are separately pinned; complete joins anchors_wanted only under the unchanged whole-worktree --base/no --paths gate and record_local_review runs solely on the assembled success result, with the compat test asserting before=(challenge,findings,head,true) then after=(complete,passed,head,true) on a real repo through the real writer, so no fixture shortcut masks the completion write; the development-completion sentence matches hook and controller behavior; the recorded counts reconcile once the follow-up's 32nd wording probe is separated from the 31-case runs (26/5, 31/0, 27/4 on the 31-case suite; 32/0 and prior-hook-fails-one on the follow-up), so no evidence mismatch stands.

Containment holds for this shared-gate change: the hook stays non-blocking, never executes receipt content (jq --arg), prints only the self-computed git-dir receipt path, and still degrades to silence on malformed receipts via the hex guard and || true; the controller change is a two-line extension of an existing anchor gate plus one call to the existing no-follow receipt writer on an existing success path, the failed-completion case is pinned byte-identical by cmp -s, the completion receipt binds the anchor-sampled HEAD (dirty-at-complete records worktree_clean=false, which the hook never treats as quiet), and no verdict, budget, chain, or authorization logic is touched.

challenge_focus: Break the follow-up: make the dispositions receipt case pass while the controller would not record on a real disposition closure (fixture shortcuts, receipts written by review/challenge masking completion), make the status-less reminder branch fire for findings or stay quiet, or show the added development-completion sentence contradicting the hook, the controller, or other clauses in that reference. Also retry the original attacks: quiet reminder with outstanding findings, passed receipt recorded for a HEAD or tree no conclusive review covered.
